II. CONDITIONAL ORIGIN AND CLASSIC MEANING

1. Dependent Origination

In the Dharma assembly there was a great Pham Chi (Brahman) named Unconstructed Miraculous Light, outstandingly intelligent, respectful of the Three Jewels, always wishing for the benefit and peace of living beings. He came to pay his respects and respectfully invited the Buddha and the assembly to come to his house the next morning to receive offerings.

The next morning, on the way, the World-Honored One and the crowd headed to Pham Chi's house. While passing through the Phong Tai garden, the Buddha came to a ruined ancient stupa (broken earthen mound). At that moment, from the ground station, a great stream of brilliant light emitted and a voice of praise was heard: “How good, how good is Shakyamuni World-Honored One!”.

The World-Honored One immediately came to the tower to pay homage, circumambulated three times to the right, took off his upper robe, covered the tower, and shed tears; Buddhas appearing in the ten directions simultaneously shed tears and radiate blessings.

The Venerable Vajrapāṇi (Vajrapāṇi) was moved and respectfully asked the reason. The World-Honored One declared that: That seemingly desolate pile of land is actually a wonderful great stupa, inside which are accumulated the entire body relics of all the past, present and future Buddhas, along with 84,000 dharma teachings and ninety-nine billion cu branches of the Tathagata. The reason for that rare holiness is because inside it contains HINDRA NI TREASURES (The secret mantra of the whole body and relics in the hearts of all Tathagata).

2. Name and Dharma seal

• "Bao Khiep" (寶篋): A treasure chest, a jade box containing priceless treasures.

• "Seal" (印): The seal, the immutable heart seal, guarantees the truth of liberation.

III. COMPLETE SUTRA TEXT (VIETNAMESE VERSION TRANSLATED NGUYEN THUAN)

Full translation from the source of Applied Buddhism (phatphapungdung.com), comparing the Chinese translation of the Tripitaka Unempty.

This is what I heard:

Once upon a time, the Buddha lived at Bao Quang Minh lake, in Vo Cau garden of Thien Thang country. At that time, there were immeasurable hundreds of thousands of great Bodhisattvas, great Sravakas, heavens, dragons, celestial beings, flying stars, golden birds, skeptics, great pythons, humans and non-humans surrounding the World-Honored One.

At that time in the assembly there was a great Pham Chi named Vo Cau Dieu Quang, intelligent and learned, he felt joy, and always practiced the Ten Good Karmas. He took refuge and deeply believed in the Three Jewels. He has sharp wisdom, always wishing all sentient beings to achieve good benefits and be rich and prosperous.

At that time, Pham Chi Nhat Cau Dieu Quang stood up from his seat, went to the Buddha's place, circumambulated him seven times, and held incense and flowers to worship the World-Honored One. Next, he took a beautiful priceless robe, strung a rosary, and a jeweled necklace to wrap it around the Buddha.

After that, he bowed with his forehead touching Tathagata's feet, then stood aside and respectfully said:

“We respectfully request the World-Honored One and the assembly to come to my house tomorrow morning to receive offerings!”

At that time, the World-Honored One silently promised. When he learned that Buddha had accepted, Pham Chi immediately returned. That very night, he prepared a lot of delicious food and drinks with hundreds of flavors, sprinkled water, swept the hall, and hung parasols.

“The time has come, I respectfully hope that the World-Honored One will come.”

“In order to bring great benefits to that Pham Chi, all disciples should go to his house to receive offerings.”

At that time, the World-Honored One immediately stood up from his seat. As soon as he stood up, the Buddha's whole body emitted all kinds of light. They blend with beautiful colors and shine in all ten directions. When everywhere is aware, then that light will disappear.

With reverence accompanying Tathagata, at that time Pham Chi held the wonderful incense of flowers, along with his relatives, the eight-fold heavenly dragon, De Thich, Brahma, and the Four Heavenly Kings walking in front leading the way.

At that time, the World-Honored One went not far ahead and came to a garden called Phong Tai. In that garden there is an ancient tower that is rotten, damaged, and lying on its side. Thorns and thorns are overgrown in the front yard, weeds cover the gateway, stone tiles are buried, and it resembles an earthen station.

At that time, the World-Honored One went straight to the stupa. At that moment, light and bright light appeared on the tower.

A voice of praise rang out in the fort saying:

“How good, how good, Śākyamuni Buddha! Your actions today are truly an extremely good realm. And as for Pham Chi, today you will receive great good benefits.”

At that time, the World-Honored One paid homage to that old stupa, circumambulated to the right three times, and took off the upper part of the clothes he was wearing to cover that place. At that time, tears mixed with the World-Honored One's blood flowed down. When he finished choking back tears, he smiled.

At that time, the Buddhas of the ten directions looked at each other and also shed tears. Then each of them released light to shine on this tower. At that time, the crowd was extremely surprised, their faces changed, and everyone wanted to answer their doubts.

At that time Vajrapani Bodhisattva and the others also shed tears.

He held the burning vajra and danced it around, then went to the Buddha's place and said:

At that time, the World-Honored One told him Vajrapani:

Hey Vajrapani! Because there is this essential Dharma in it, the tower immediately turns into one after another, without a single gap like sesame seeds piled on top of each other.

Tathagata's 99 billion great signs are also in there.

When the masses heard the Buddha's teachings, they all left the world, cut off all afflictions, and attained the pure Dharma eye. Because the fundamentals of the masses are different, the benefits each person achieves are also different. There are those who attain Stream-Entering, Once-Returning, Never-Returning, or Non-Training Paths. There is a person who attains the Solitary Enlightenment. There is a Bodhisattva who practices the Bodhisattva Way and attains All-Wisdom, or can never regress. Or there are those who attain the First Ground, the Second Ground, and up to the Tenth Ground. Or has the full taste of Six Degrees. As for Pham Chi, he can stay away from the world and attain five types of supernatural powers.

When he saw this rare and special event, Vajrapani said:

Buddha said:

“Listen, Vajrapani! In the next life, if there are good men and women and any of my four disciples who have the heart to copy this Sutra, it will be equivalent to copying 99 billion Sutras of all the Sutras preached by the Tathagata. This merit is even greater than the good roots they have planted in front of the 99 billion Tathagata. In addition, they will also be accepted by all the other Tathagata. Reciting protective thoughts is like loving your own eyes, just like a good mother loves and protects her children.

If anyone reads and recites this Sutra, it means reading and reciting all the Sutras of the past, present, and future preached by the Buddhas.

Due to reciting this Sutra, 99 billion Tathagata, Saṅgha, Saṅgha, and Perfect Enlightenment all came, one after another, as dense as sesame seeds stacked on top of each other, without a single gap. Day and night, all the other Buddhas appear to bless that person.

Countless Ganges and all the Buddhas and Tathagatas are like that, some of them have not yet left, but some of them have come together again. Buddhas suddenly come and go, like fine sand swirling in a rushing stream. Buddhas go and come again–without any stagnation.

If someone takes incense, flowers, incense sticks, wreaths, clothes, and wonderful decorative objects to make offerings to this Sutra, then it is the same as if they took the scent of heavenly flowers, clothes, and ornaments decorated with the seven treasures, and that number is accumulated like the Wonderful Mountain, and makes all the offerings in front of 99 billion Tathagata. The good roots they planted in this Sutra are the same.”

When the eight-step heavenly dragon, humans and non-humans heard those words, everyone was surprised, then they said to each other:

Vajrapani said to the Buddha:

Buddha told Vajrapani:

“This is not a land fort, but a great and wonderful tower of precious treasures. Because of the low karma of sentient beings, it is hidden and does not appear. Even though the tower is hidden, the Tathagata's entire body cannot be destroyed. How can the Tathagata's body, the Vajra organs, be destroyed?

After I am nirvana, in the time of the Dharma Ending Force later on, if any sentient beings create illegal karma and must fall into hell, do not believe in the Three Jewels, and do not plant good roots, because of that cause and effect, the Buddha Dharma will disappear. However, this tower is still solid and immortal. That is because of the divine blessings of all Tathagata. Due to karma, ignorant beings do not know how to dig it up to use this treasure. That is why I am now shedding tears, and those Tathagata are also shedding tears."

The Buddha again told Vajrapani:

According to your ability, build a tower of earth, wood, stone, or brick and decorate it with parasols, nets, paths, tables, roofs, wind chimes, foundations, or steps. Due to the power of the Sutra, the stupa will naturally become seven treasures. Furthermore, all Tathagatas will increase the power of this Sutra. With sincere words, the Tathagata will bless without interruption.

If there are any sentient beings who can worship and make offerings to even a single stick of incense or a single flower branch in front of this tower, their 80 million mortal sins will be instantly annihilated. In this present life, they are free from disasters, and when they die, they will be reborn in the house of the Buddhas.

That place will not be damaged by wind, storms or thunder.

• That place will not be disturbed by poisonous snakes, scorpions, or other harmful insects.

• That place will not be harmed by lions, crazy elephants, tigers, wolves, wild animals, bees, or centipedes.

• That place is not terrorized by yaksha, rakshasa, demon spirits, semen-sucking ghosts, goblins, or epilepsy.

• That place is also not infected with any heat or cold diseases, ulcers, leprosy, or ulcers.

If anyone catches a glimpse of this tower, they will be able to eliminate all accidents. Six types of livestock, adults, and young girls and boys will not be infected by pestilence.

They will not die unjustly or die suddenly.

They will not be harmed by knives, sticks, water or fire.

They will not be harmed by thieves or enemies.

• They also don't have to worry about hunger or poverty.

The evil spell will not harm them.

• The Four Heavenly Kings and their relatives will protect them day and night.

• All dragon kings will make rain at the right time and increase their vitality.

• All the gods, including the gods in the Thirty-Third heaven, will fly down three times a day to make offerings to them.

• All the immortals will gather three times a day to circumambulate the tower, sing songs, worship, give thanks, and contemplate.

That place is immediately protected and blessed by all Tathagata. Because there is this Sutra in the tower, such things happen.

If anyone uses earth, stone, wood, gold, silver, copper, or lead to build a tower, then writes down this mantra and places it inside, when it is just placed, that tower will become a tower of seven treasures. The steps above and below, the open table, the canopy, the wind chimes, and the rotunda will be made entirely of seven treasures. The four sides of the tower have the image of Tathagata. Because of the weak Dharma, all Tathagata will steadfastly protect day and night without leaving. Due to the power of the mantra, the seven-jeweled tower containing the wonderful treasures of the entire body of relics will soar high into the middle of the Heaven of the Color of Salvation; The tower stands tall. All the gods day and night will admire, protect, and make offerings."

Vajra Venerable said:

“World-Honored One! Because of what causes and conditions does this Dharma have such outstanding merit?”

Buddha said:

“We must know that this is due to the mighty power of Bao Khiep's Mantra Seal.”

Vajrapani said:

“We hope Tathagata will have mercy on us and preach this mantra.”

Buddha said:

“Listen, think, and don't forget! The glorious incarnations of all Tathagata in the present and future and the entire body relics of the past Buddhas are all in the Bao Khiet Mantra Seal. The three bodies of those Tathagata are also in here.”

At that time, the World-Honored One immediately said to him:

At that time, Buddha told Vajrapani:

I will now summarize one-tenth of those benefits. Please remember and practice to benefit all.

After death, if any evil person falls into hell to suffer uninterruptedly without a time to get out, such as any of their descendants calling the name of the ghost and chanting the above mantra, then after completing the seven transformations, the hot copper and iron will suddenly turn into a pond of eight merits, with lotus flowers supporting the feet, and a treasured parasol covering the sinner's head. At that time, the gates of hell were broken and the Bodhi Path opened wide. Then that lotus flower will carry them to the Pure Land. When born in that land, the Omniscience will naturally manifest. They will greatly enjoy teaching the Dharma and attain the status of One Birth Bodhisattva.

Suppose there was a person who, due to greed and stinginess, had to be born into a mean family, with clothes not enough to cover his body, food not enough to cover his stomach, skinny and withered, and everyone who saw him despised him. But if this person feels ashamed and embarrassed, they go into the forest to pick wild flowers, grind rotten wood to make incense powder, then go to the stupa to make offerings, circumambulate to the right seven times, and shed tears to repent of their mistakes, then because of the divine power of the mantra and the mighty virtue of the stupa, their poor retribution will immediately be destroyed. Wealth suddenly comes, seven treasures fall like rain, and they will not lack anything. At that time, they need to respect Buddha Dharma and give alms to the needy. If they are stingy and stingy, their wealth will suddenly disappear.

Suppose there is someone who wants to plant good roots, so they use mud or bricks to build a tower according to their ability. That tower may be as big as an amla fruit and four inches high. After that, they wrote down the mantra, placed it inside the tower, and then held incense and flowers to make offerings and worship. Due to the power of this mantra and their faith, in the small tower, a large cloud of incense will naturally emit. The scent and light of the cloud cover the entire Dharma Realm, faintly fragrant, and widely do Buddha's work. The merit they will gain is the same as mentioned above. In short, no wish can be fulfilled.

If someone comes to the tower to pray for blessings, they bring a stick of incense or a flower branch to make offerings, worship, and walk around to the right, it is because of that merit:

Glorious mandarin, no one wants to come.

Wealth and wealth last a long time, don't expect to increase by yourself.

The bandits are unjust, if they don't fight, they will defeat themselves.

Resentful chanting of spells will not go away on its own.

The disease and evil spirits cannot be avoided.

A good husband and a good wife cannot pray for themselves.

Good boys and beautiful girls, don't expect to be born on their own.

All wishes, fulfilled at will.

If there are crows, hawks, sparrows, crows, howlers, pigeons, owls, wolves, wildcats, flies, mosquitoes, ants, or other insects, but only temporarily come under the shadow of the tower or step on the grass there, then their karma will be broken and they will realize ignorance. They will suddenly enter the Buddha's house and freely receive Dharma wealth. What's more, if anyone sees the tower, hears the sound of the bell, hears the name, or stays under the shadow of the tower, all their sins will be eliminated, their wishes will be fulfilled, their life will be peaceful, and when they die, they will be born in the Pure Land.

If someone, according to their ability, uses a piece of mud to fill in the broken brick, or holds a small stone against the leaning tower, due to this merit, they will receive increased blessings and longevity. After death, that person will be born as a King of Chakravarti.

After my passing away, if there are any of the four disciples who want to save sentient beings in the world of suffering, they should stand in front of this stupa and make offerings of incense and flowers, wholeheartedly make vows, and recite mantras. At that time, each word and each sentence of the mantra will magnify the light, shine on sentient beings in the three evil paths, and eliminate all suffering. When living beings have escaped the yoke of suffering, the Buddha seed will sprout; They will be reborn in the pure lands of the ten directions at will.

If someone on a high mountain top recites this mantra wholeheartedly, then all sentient beings within their sight – including those with feathers, scales, or shells – residing near or far, in valleys, mountains, forests, streams, rivers, lakes, or oceans, will immediately have their karma destroyed. They will realize ignorance, manifest the original existence of the three types of Buddha nature, and ultimately enter the peaceful land of Great Nirvana.

If anyone walks along the path of the person reciting the mantra, such as the wind blowing through their clothes, or stepping on footprints, or only seeing the face, or just having a few words with the person reciting the mantra, then the serious sins of such people will be eliminated and their body, speech, and mind karma will be completed."

At that time, Buddha told Vajrapani:

“I now entrust this secret mantra and Sutra to you. Please respect, protect and pass it on in the world. Pass on the life to sentient beings and do not let it be cut off.”

Vajrapani said:

If there are any sentient beings who write down, accept, uphold, and always remember, then we will send Indra, Pham Vuong, Four Heavenly Kings, and the heavenly dragons to protect them day and night and never temporarily leave them."

Buddha said:

After the World-Honored One had preached this Bao Khiep Seal Mantra and finished doing extensive Buddhist work, he went to Pham Chi's house to receive offerings, in order to cause gods and humans to receive great blessings. After that, he returned to his native land.

V. FULL TEXT OF THE CLASSIC CONTRAST TEXT (VIETNAMESE TRANSLATION BY SAMON THICHYEN DUC - 1977)

Classical Sino-Vietnamese translation by the late monk Thich Vien Duc (September 1977), helping to compare traditional Tantric Buddhist nouns.

As I have heard, at one time the Buddha was in the country of Maga-da in the Vo Cau garden, the Bao Quang Minh pond, with the great Bodhisattvas and great Sravakas, Heavenly Dragons, Yaksha, Gandharva, Asura, Ca-lau-la, Khanna-la, Maha-la-gia, people and non-human beings. ...etc, countless hundreds of thousands of times before and after being surrounded and disturbed.

At that time, the Brahman Unattached Wonderful Light stood up from the throne, went to the Buddha, circumambulated him seven times, brought incense and flowers to the Buddha, a priceless robe, a string of pearls, and precious pearls to the Buddha. He prostrated himself with both feet, then retreated and sat to one side and said: "We hope that the World-Honored One and the assembly, tomorrow morning, will come to my house and receive their blessings." my offerings.”

At that time, the World-Honored One silently promised, and the Uncapped Wonderful Light Brahman, knowing that the Buddha had received the request, immediately returned home. That same night, a large set of hundreds of people were set up to eat delicious delicacies, swept the halls, hung garlands, and told them to do so. In the morning, he and his relatives brought incense, flowers, and music to the Tathagata and said: "The time has come, bow down and look forward to it." He comes.”

At that time, the World-Honored One immediately stood up from the throne. As soon as he stood from the throne, from the Buddha's body all kinds of bright rays of light flowed out, mysterious colors shining one after another, shocking the ten directions and enlightening all, and then he left. At that time, the Brahmin paid his respects, held magical incense and flowers, along with his relatives and the Heavenly Dragons, Thich Pham, and the Four Kings went ahead to repair the roads to worship and lead the Tathagata.

At that time, the World-Honored One, not far ahead, arrived in a garden called Phong Tai. In that garden, there is an ancient tower that is ruined and fallen, covered with thorns and thorns, covered with plants and trees, and buried brick and tile doors like mounds of dirt. At that time, the World-Honored One moved his heels and walked over to the tower. On the magnifying tower, a halo of light shined brightly, from within the pile of soil, a voice of praise was heard saying: "How good, how good! Shakyamuni has achieved an extremely good state today! Again Brahman, today you have reaped great benefits."

At that time, the World-Honored One paid homage to that stupa, circumambulated three times, took off his clothes and covered that stupa, his eyes shed tears, blood flowed alternately, crying and then he smiled. At that time, all the Buddhas in the ten directions shed tears and sent rays of light to shine on that tower. Seeing this, the crowd changed their faces in surprise and together prayed to Buddha to resolve their doubts.

At that time, Vajrapani Bodhisattva...etc., also shed tears of majesty and radiance like red fire, holding pestles and dancing around, went to the Buddha, and told the World-Honored One: "What is the cause and condition for such a halo to appear? Why is the Tathagata shedding tears like that? The Buddhas of the ten directions also have signs of a halo of light appearing? We bow to the Tathagata for this. This mass of people will explain your doubts.”

At that time the Buddha taught: "Dear Vajrapani, the Tathagata's entire body of relics is stored in this stupa. All the immeasurable cu-chi Mind Dharani secret essence of the Tathagata is now in there. Vajrapani, because there is this essence of the Dharma in there, the stupa has transformed into a multi-layered structure without a single gap even as large as a sesame seed, with hundreds of thousands of cu-chi bodies." Tathagata, you must know that it is like a sesame seed. Hundreds of thousands of Tathagata's entire body relics are gathered there, up to eighty-four thousand dharma aggregates are also in there, 99 hundred thousand ten thousand cu-chi of Tathagata's crowned appearance are also in there, so this stupa has great miracles, surpassing virtue, fulfilling all good joy in the world."

At that time, when the crowd heard what the Buddha said, they were able to separate themselves from the worldly attachments, end all afflictions, and attain pure Dharma. How many of them then get different benefits. There are people who attain the Sotapanna fruition, the Sotapanna fruition, the Anahamma fruition, the Arahant fruition, the Pratyekabuddha path and the Bodhisattva path, the Abbottāra wisdom (irreversible), the Saṅgāra wisdom (One-piece wisdom), such things, each person attains one. Or there is a person who attains the First Ground, the Second Ground and the Ten Grounds, or there is a taste of the full six Paramitas.

That Brahmin also left the world and possessed the five supernatural powers.

Buddha taught: "Hey Vajrapani, please listen! In the future, if there are good men, faithful women and four sets of my disciples who have the heart to copy and write this sutra, that is, in the plain, 99 hundred thousand thousand cu-chi of all the sutras of the Tathagata have been mentioned, that is, they have long planted good roots in the place before the 99 hundred thousand thousand cu-chi Tathagata, and will gain all the virtues of the Tathagata. Lai ấy gia trì hộ niệm thương yêu như đôi tròng mắt, cũng như mẹ hiền thương con trẻ. Nếu người đọc tụng một quyển kinh này liền bằng đọc tụng kinh điển quá khứ, hiện tại, vị lai của chư Phật. Do như thế đó, nên 99 trăm ngàn vạn cu-chi hết thảy Như Lai Ứng Chánh đẳng giác kín khắp không chỗ hở cũng như hạt mè, trùng điệp đến đây, ngày đêm hiện thân gia trì cho người tu hành. Vô số Hằng hà sa hết thảy các đức Như Lai như thế, trước tụ tập If you haven't left yet, the next one will come in succession, go away for a moment and then come back, like small sand in a whirlpool that never stops.If someone takes fragrant flowers, incense sticks, garlands, or fully adorned mystical clothes to make offerings to this sutra, then it is the same as making offerings to the 99,000,000,000,000,000 Tathagata in the ten directions before the 99,000,000,000,000,000 Tathagata, with their fully adorned clothes, the seven treasures as full as Mount Meru, making offerings, and cultivating good roots is the same."

Buddha taught: "Hey Vajrapani! This is not a pile of dirt but a wonderful great stupa. Due to the lack of karma of sentient beings, it is hidden but not revealed. Because the stupa is hidden, Tathagata's entire body cannot be destroyed. Is it possible that Tathagata's Vajra body can be destroyed? After my nirvana, the Dharma-Ending Age will encounter a time of oppression, because there are sentient beings who practice the practice. illegal, worthy of hell, not believing in the Three Jewels, not cultivating good roots, because of that cause and effect, the Buddha Dharma must be hidden. However, the stupa is still strong and does not perish. All the divine powers of the Tathagata have been blessed, ignorant beings are obscured, and they are in vain and do not know how to use them

Furthermore, the Buddha taught: "Dear Vajrapani! If there are sentient beings who copy and write this sutra and put it in a stupa, that tower is the Vajragarbha of all Tathagatas (multi-storey tower), and also the Mind Dharani that secretly blesses the tava-ba of all Tathagata, which is 99 hundred thousand thousand cu-chi of Tathagata. Yi-pour-ba, is also the Buddha's birth, the Buddha-eye of all Tathagata, that is, all Tathagata's great divine power. If you place this sutra in the Buddha statue, in the Yi-pour-ba, then the statue will be like seven treasures, fulfilling the mind without any wish that is not fulfilled. With that rat-pour-ba, use the ash parasol, or the canopy, or the rotunda, or the bronze tray, or the bell, or the spiritual costume. Depending on your strength, arrange it on all four sides, either earth or wood, or stone or brick, with the power of the sutra to create seven treasures. All Tathagata will bless this stupa with divine power and sincerely bless it without ceasing.

If there is a sentient being who uses a stick of incense or a branch of flowers to worship and make offerings to this tower, all eighty million mortal sins of birth and death will be destroyed, they will live free of calamities, and they will die and be born in the Buddha realm. If there is a sentient being who is worthy of falling into the Avici Hell, if he worships this stupa once and is disturbed once, then the gates of hell will be closed and the path to Bodhi will be opened. The divine power of all Tathagata blesses the place where there are stupas and images. That place is not harmed by windstorms, lightning, thunder, poisonous snakes, snakes, scorpions, poisonous insects, poisonous animals, not hurt by lions, crazy elephants, tigers, leopards, wild animals, bees and spiders, nor by Yak-xa, Rakshasa, Bo-da, Bhi-xa-price, delusion, hopelessness, crazy fear, nor all diseases of cold, heat, scabies, cancer, scabies, scabies. hmm, leprosy causes infection.

If someone temporarily sees this tower, accidents can be ruled out. In that place, there were no humans, horses, cattle, boys, girls, epidemic diseases, premature death, knives, sticks, water and fire, no robbers, robbers, hatred or harm, nor fear of sadness, hunger, thirst or deprivation. Evil curses cannot lie in wait to harm you. The Four Great Heavenly Kings and their relatives guard them day and night. Twenty-eight sets of great Medicine-massage Generals, Sun-Moon and Five-Stars, Clouds (stars) Wisdom Stars (comets) protect day and night. All the Dragon Kings gave more essence, and when the rain fell, all the Gods and the Dao-loi Thien of three periods of time came to make offerings. All the three-time immortals gathered together, chanted and worshiped, worshiped and contemplated. Thich-de-perfect-nhon and the Goddesses day and night three times came down to make offerings. That place is the place where all Tathagata protect and bless. Because this sutra is kept in the tower, it is like that.

If someone builds a tower using soil, stone, wood, gold, silver, copper and lead, writes down this mantra and puts it in there. Once the tower is installed, it becomes seven treasures. On and off the platform are exposed parasols, spirit bells, and pure chakras, which are seven treasures. That tower is the form of the Tathagata in the four directions. Because of that Dharma essence, all Tathagata firmly abide and protect him day and night without leaving. That tower of seven treasures is the Wonderful Museum of all body relics. Because the power of the mantra soared high, as high as the Akanitra heavenly palace, where the tower stood alone, all the gods day and night admired the protector and made offerings."

At that time, the World-Honored One immediately said to the dharani:

**[DA-RANI HAS BEEN CONSIDERED IN SECTION IV.3]**

At that time, the Buddha taught Vajrapani: "Listen to such an essential dharma, its power is infinite, its benefits are boundless, just like on a flag hanging a pearl of Wish-fulfilling pearls that often rains down all the precious treasures, fulfilling all your wishes. I now only summarize a part of the ten thousand parts, you should remember it for the benefit of all. If there is an evil person who dies and falls into hell, suffering endless suffering, there is no day to escape, if There is a descendant of that person who recites the name of the deceased, recites the above mantra for seven times, then in the boiling water of hell, a hot iron ball suddenly turns into a pond of cool water with eight types of merit, immediately gives birth to a lotus flower supporting that person's feet, a treasure chest covers the head, the gates of hell are destroyed, the path of Bodhi is opened, that lotus flower flies straight to the world of Ultimate Bliss, the Omniscience naturally emerges, infinite joy, and the place of nourishment.

There are sentient beings whose sins are deeply serious, hundreds of diseases afflict their bodies, and their minds are suffering and pressing. Recite this mantra 21 times, hundreds of diseases, ten thousand brain problems will be eliminated at once, and you will have a long life with endless blessings.

If someone is born in a poor house because of greed in his previous life's karma, not enough clothes to cover his body, not enough food to fill his mouth, and is thin and ugly, everyone will hate and scold him. He shamefully goes into the mountains to pick the flowers of the Anarcha, or grinds rotten trees to get the fragrance (the agarwood core inside the tree trunk), goes to the stupa to worship and make offerings to this sutra, circumambulates seven times, shedding tears of repentance. Due to the magical power and virtue of the tower, the retribution of poverty can be eliminated, leading to wealth, the seven treasures flow like rain, and there is no longer any need. At this time, you should only make offerings to Buddha Dharma and give alms to the poor. If you are too greedy and hoarding, your wealth will naturally be lost.

If there are people who want to grow good roots, they can create a tower, either mud or clay, depending on their ability to arrange it, as big as an yam-ma-la fruit, four fingers high, copy and write the mantra and then place it in the tower. When the ceremony is complete, offer incense and flowers, worship and make offerings. Thanks to the power of that mantra and faith, from the small tower comes a great fragrance cloud, that fragrance covers like clouds in the sky, the halo spreads throughout the dharma world. The fragrance is fragrant, the light shines wonderfully, and the practitioner will receive merit as mentioned above.

In short, there is no wish that cannot be fulfilled. If there are four groups of disciples, good men and women, faithful in the Dharma-Ending Age, for the sake of the Supreme Way, they will do their best to create stupas, secure mantras, and reap the merits that cannot be exhausted.

If someone praying for blessings comes to that tower, brings a fragrant flower, a stick of precious incense, worships, makes offerings, and circumscribes the practice of religion, because of that merit, high-ranking officials do not ask for it but come on their own, live long and are rich without expecting it but increase on their own, unjust thieves and robbers do not fight but run away on their own, resentment and curses do not curse but return to their roots. Diseases and evil spirits cannot be avoided but can be avoided by themselves. A good husband and a good wife will be born without asking for it. A good man and a beautiful girl will be born without asking for it. All wishes are fully optional.

If birds like crows, sparrows, howlers, owls, pigeons, forest wolves, wild canines, mosquitoes, ants, and flies touch the tower, step on the grass on the base of the tower, immediately destroy the obstacles, become enlightened in ignorance, immediately enter the Buddha's world and receive the Dharma, much less those who see the tower, or hear the sound of bells, or hear the name of the tower, or the shadow of the tower touching the body, then how many sinful obstacles are there? Everything is destroyed, whatever you seek, your present life is peaceful, and you will be born in the Ultimate Bliss. Or some people, according to their strength, take a piece of soil to cover the damaged area of ​​the tower, or reach out and pick up a stone to put it where the tower is leaning. Due to this merit, they will increase their blessings and have a long life, and after their death, they will become a Chakravartin King.

If, after my nirvana, the four groups of disciples facing the place in front of the stupa want to help the suffering world, they should make offerings of incense and flowers, wholeheartedly make a vow to recite mantras, texts, owls (word by word, sentence by sentence), magnifying the light to radiate to the three realms of (hells, hungry ghosts, animals) all suffering will be eliminated, sentient beings will be freed from suffering, and Buddha will immediately sprout. reborn, reborn at will in the ten pure lands.

If someone goes straight to the top of a high mountain and chants the mantra with his mind focused, his eyes can see anywhere, whether near or far, such as mountains, caves, forests, streams, lakes, rivers and seas, in which there are cilia, feathers, scales, horns and antlers, all of which are dissolved, enlightenment of ignorance, manifesting the original three-piece Buddha nature, and finally finding peace in the great Nirvana.

If you and the person reciting the mantra cross the path, or the wind blows and touches him, or your feet step on the practitioner's footprints, or you only see his face, or briefly exchange words, all those who meet like that will have their mortal sins destroyed, and their dharma will be perfected.

Kim Cang Thu said: "I am now fortunate to be entrusted by the World-Honored One. We bow down to the World-Honored One. We, in order to deeply repay the Buddha's kindness, protect and propagate all day and night to the world. If there are sentient beings who write, copy, accept and maintain, remember and recite without forgetting, we will order Thich, Pham Tu Vuong, and the Dragon Gods to guard day and night without temporarily abandoning them. (person reciting this mantra).”

At that time, the World-Honored One said the Treasure of Dharani, widely used to do Buddha's work. Later, she went to that Brahmin's house to receive the offerings, causing the Heavenly people to reap great benefits at that time and then return to their original place.

At that time, the great assembly of Bhikkhus, Bhikkhunis, Upasakas, Upasayas, Celestial Dragons, Yakshas, Gandharvas, Asuras, Kalahasas, Khannalas, Mahoulayas, people and non-human beings, etc., all rejoiced. joy, faith and worship.
